gate.as: eval/headgate_protocol.json 'gate' and 'training', unchanged, on the VOCR6 blob of the tier
gate.data: the console-cut crops of VOCR5's own fine-tune pools as stored (own_grad, own_ref, nat_grad, nat_ref, dntv_grad, dntv_ref, dnst_grad, dnst_ref; the eight sha256 of eval/headgate_protocol.json training.files), every row; hygiene asserted (no eval/manifests/reserved.json test or dev_sample VN)
gate.features: per frame, the head input (vocr_extra.head_in) from the C runtime in W8I with the VOCR6 blob (with an attention op: z', the attention's output, which is the head's input)
gate.label: y = the frame's W8I argmax is the blank
gate.split: by VN: sha1(vn) % 5 == 0 calibrates, the rest fits
gate.fit: standardised inputs; Linear(96, 16), ReLU, Linear(16, 1); BCEWithLogits; Adam lr 3e-3, cosine over 12 epochs of batches of 4,096, seed 0, torch threads 1; one fit per tier, nothing chosen among fits
gate.export: standardisation folded into layer 1, layer 1 int8 per hidden unit, the rest float32; a VOCG section after the unchanged blob (train/headgate.py)
gate.threshold: eps = 1e-3: t = the (floor(eps n) + 1)-th largest exact int8 score of the n calibration frames whose argmax is not the blank
gate.fallback: eps = 1e-4 from the same fit (written beside it by the same command); used only as 'decision' says
gate.checks: train/headgate.py fit's own: the C runtime's scores equal the twin's bit for bit on every calibration line, skipped counts and skipped frames blank; else the run stops
gate.code: train/headgate.py features / fit (option --prefix VOCR6 names the outputs VOCR6_<T>_w8g.vocr; nothing else changes)

two_level.permutation: train/head2level.py permute of the VOCR6 blob with that ranking (every class's logit unchanged bit for bit)
two_level.frequent_set: K_alt re-derived from the VOCR6 permuted blob's own frames: for K in [500, 750, 1000, 1250, 1750, 2000, 2500] the K's r96 escape fit and thresholded as escape_training, W(K) = L1 + 16.5 + f_cal (V_pad - L1), K_alt = argmin W (ties: the larger K), eligible with >= 200 fit and >= 50 calibration positives (eval/head2level_fit.py escapes, which also fits K = 1,500, reported only)
two_level.rare_variant: r96 only: the head's own rare rows (#122 rejected every r48 arm; the merged runtime refuses r48 trailers)
two_level.escape_training: #122's: every row of the eight console-cut files plus rp3_grad's seeded 40,000-row sample (default_rng(20261023)), as stored; features from the C runtime in W8I with the permuted VOCR6 blob (head input, level 1's l1 and b0), label = the W8I argmax lies outside level 1; split sha1(vn) % 5; Linear(98, 16) - ReLU - Linear(16, 1), BCE pos_weight min(100, neg / pos), Adam 3e-3, cosine, 12 epochs of 4,096, seed 0, torch threads 5; folded, layer 1's head-input weights int8 per hidden unit
two_level.threshold: recall >= 0.999 on the calibration positives (t = the largest float32 below the (floor(0.001 n) + 1)-th smallest positive score)
two_level.fallback: recall 0.9999 from the same fit; used only as 'decision' says
two_level.blobs: VOCR6_<T>_2L_K<K>_r96.vocr (permuted blob + VOC2 trailer) and VOCR6_<T>_2Lg_K<K>_r96.vocr (= VOCR6_<T>_w8g2.vocr: the permuted blob, the tier's adopted VOCG gate bound again to it, the VOC2 trailer; eval/head2level_fit.py build / compose)

estimates.arms: per tier: the gated blob with the gate off, score-only and on (#120); for N and L also the ungated blob, the gate, 2L and 2Lg at K_alt, and the 2L blob retargeted to t = +inf and -inf (#122's projection)

estimates.report: per tier and configuration: ms per frame and the nominal box at 333 MHz and at 444 MHz (the cycle model at 444 MHz, docs/vocr5.md's table; the finder's 100 ms unscaled), with and without prefetch credit; the real box (89 frames); MACs per frame (export.macs_per_frame, full head) and the effective MACs per frame at wd's skip and escape shares; int8 blob bytes and the VOCG / VOC2 bytes; the W8I arena at 1,024 px with the gate and the two-level head on and off (vocr_arena_bytes, equal to export.plan_arena)

amendments.why: vocr6-lead's request (2026-10-27 ~06:05Z, pane message): to shorten the critical path, run the driver provisionally on stage 4b's blobs as they land, before its FINAL BLOBS message (~09:15Z), which then confirms each tier's blob

provisional_inputs.note: each one's sha256 enters OUT/<T>/input.json when its preparation starts; none existed at this amendment

amendments.confirmation: FINAL BLOBS names one blob per tier. A tier whose provisional input has the named blob's sha256 is confirmed: its provisional work is the run's. A tier named otherwise (a 4a sibling, VOCR5) is redone on the named blob: its provisional directories move to OUT/superseded/ and PRIV/superseded/ (recorded in OUT/superseded.jsonl; their steps are reported apart in the timing, not as the run's), and every tier whose cascade chain reaches a redone tier is decided again (S if N is redone; N and S if L is redone; eval/vocr6_gate.py redo_plan). Nothing provisional is reported to vocr6-lead as the result, or ships, unless FINAL BLOBS names it
amendments.order: tiers are prepared as their blobs land (S, N, L) and decided in the protocol's order (L, N, S: decision.order, unchanged), each cascade into the next tier's blob of the same seed (stage 4b's seed 1 at every tier)
amendments.jobs: with two slots, a second job makes a tier's VOCR6-path dumps, its fallback arms' reads, A9 measurements and dumps, and its primary arms' counter sets while the first runs the fits; the jobs share the driver's step records under a lock per step (flock, released when a job dies), so each step runs once and nothing waits on a dead job. A step made ahead (a fallback arm's) is the step decide would make: no rule, threshold or arm changes
amendments.affects: no rule and no decision: the same steps, rules and order; only when steps run and on which provisional inputs, confirmed before anything is reported
